messages:
Ana (PM): quick heads-up — we have a rapid hotfix build v1.8.3 targeting a memory leak in the request router. Change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Need: one-line customer blurb, internal RN copy, pin owner, and explicit rollback runway. please reply here. cc @here :rotating_light:

Ravi (Eng): canary proposal: 5% traffic for 20m in eu-west-1, check mem RSS and p99 latency. auto-fallback to v1.8.2 if mem growth > 15% sustained over 10m or errors > 1.5%.

Marco (Ops): +1. Ops suggests scheduling the deploy 22:05 so we have 55m before midnight support handoff. rollback thresholds: mem_growth_threshold = 0.15, error_rate_threshold = 0.015. prefer auto-rollback but require oncall ack before promote.

Lina (Docs): I can draft both internal and public lines. For public: one-liner that says "hotfix for memory stability, no API changes". internal will include tracing tips and links.

Ana (PM): perfect. pin owner? who will own the model/infra pin during the rollout?

Ravi (Eng): Infra team (Ravi) takes the pin. rationale: this touches router memory allocs — we want stability-first.

Sam (Oncall): Sam and Priya on watch. Runbook: http://go/runbooks/mem-leak-hotfix. Will post pager thresholds to the oncall console.

Ravi (Eng): deploying via deploy-bot. command below. will start at 22:05 UTC after last smoke.

```
/deploy release/v1.8.3 --canary=5% --duration=20m --region=eu-west-1 --smoke
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy 9f4a1b. scheduled start 22:05 UTC. monitors: system.mem.rss, redwood.runtime.errors, redwood.runtime.latency.p99.

deploy-bot: canary started at 22:05 UTC. reporting window open.

Sam (Oncall): seeing mem RSS creep on two canary instances at +12% after 8m. errors stable. Sam: tagging for attention and will wait to hit 10m before deciding.

Marco (Ops): noted. Ops capturing heap profiles via /ops/heapdump endpoint.

Ravi (Eng): I see the same. scaling canary to 8% to get more signal, keeping duration same. sending new deploy step.

```
/deploy scale 9f4a1b --canary=8%
```

deploy-bot: canary scaled to 8% at 22:13 UTC. continuing monitoring.

Sam (Oncall): after 10m mem growth hit 16% on aggregate and a spike in OOM restarts on one replica. This matches rollback rule mem_growth > 15% for 10m. Sam: issuing rollback now.

Sam (Oncall): /deploy abort 9f4a1b -> reverting to tag v1.8.2. Escalating to Marco for postmortem and decide if patch needs further tweaks.

deploy-bot: abort acknowledged. rollback complete at 22:21 UTC. current live tag: v1.8.2. summary: mem_growth 16% (trigger), errors 0.6%. :warning:

Ana (PM): thanks for catching that. Lina — hold RN draft; change the blurb to note the attempted hotfix and that it was rolled back for further analysis. Keep customer-facing messaging calm: "We attempted a hotfix tonight; no customer impact observed, rolling back to ensure stability while we investigate."

Lina (Docs): drafting now. internal snippet: "Attempted rollout v1.8.3 flagged by memory growth on canary and rolled back. Pin remains v1.8.2. Engineers collecting heap profiles; follow runbook link for triage steps."

Ravi (Eng): pin owner confirms: Infra (Ravi) keeps pin. Next steps: reproduce locally with stress test, add extra guard in allocator, then re-run canary behind dark traffic. Will post ETA after triage.

Marco (Ops): scheduling postmortem slot 10:00 UTC tomorrow. will attach logs + heapdumps. reopening change window only after signoff from oncall and infra.

Sam (Oncall): marking incident in incidents channel and notifying SRE rotation. no customer-facing alerts sent as no user-facing errors were detected.

Ana (PM): good. Lina, push internal RN to #eng-all with the calm copy and the triage note. cc infra and ops. Once triage gives go, we'll re-run the rollout with extended monitoring. closing this thread after RN is posted.

Lina (Docs): posted internal RN in #eng-all at 23:02 UTC. excerpt: "Attempted release v1.8.3 (memory leak fix) — canary showed elevated memory growth; rolled back to v1.8.2. No user-facing impact. Engineers collecting diagnostics. Postmortem scheduled."

Ravi (Eng): thanks everyone. will post triage findings and a tentative timeline.

deploy-bot: log: deploy 9f4a1b aborted and rolled back at 22:21 UTC. artifacts: ci/9f4a1b/build.log, ops/heapdump/9f4a1b/*.gz

Ana (PM): thanks team — pin owner confirmed, RN posted, rollback decision and runbook linked. closing thread.
